text_blocks.snippet: Opsumlit (macitentan) causes common side effects like a stuffy nose, sore throat, headache, and anemia.
snippet_highlighted_words: stuffy nose, sore throat, headache, and anemia

list.snippet: Nasopharyngitis: Stuffy or runny nose and sore throat.
Headache: Frequent pain in the head.
Bronchitis: Irritation or inflammation of the airways.
Anemia: Low red blood cell counts causing pale skin or tiredness.
Infections: Urinary tract infections and influenza (flu).
Severe Birth Defects: The medication causes major fetal harm. It is strictly prohibited during pregnancy, and people who can become pregnant must use birth control and monthly tests.
Liver Problems: Damage or elevated liver enzymes can occur. Watch for upper right stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, or yellow skin.
Fluid Retention: Swelling in the hands, legs, or feet can happen during early treatment.
Decreased Sperm Counts: The drug may affect male fertility.
